description: Nucleoid records an inspection after every early return
code:
audit = []
def inspect(reading):
    defer:
        audit.push(reading)
    if reading < 0:
        return -reading
    return reading * 2
assert(inspect(-3), 3)
assert(inspect(4), 8)
assert(audit, [-3, 4])
audit.length

description: Nucleoid unwinds nested registrations in reverse order
code:
events = []
def finish(code):
    defer:
        events.push(code + 1)
    defer:
        events.push(code + 2)
    return code
assert(finish(10), 10)
assert(events, [12, 11])
events.length

description: Nucleoid reads deferred work in the active exit scope while preserving a returned list
code:
observed = []
def capture(amount):
    defer:
        observed.push(amount)
        amount = 9
    amount = 4
    return [amount]
assert(capture(2), [4])
assert(observed, [4])
observed[0]
